sources.source_title: Published public defender office and professional contact evidence
sources.stated_purpose: Non-sensitive public defense administrative inquiries within actual office remit and jurisdiction.
sources.limitations: Current county contact page and biography identify officeholder; State Bar profile publishes corresponding work email. Public defenders provide representation within statutory or contracted remit and eligibility; no medical-grievance investigation or general civil intake authority is established. Do not transmit confidential material through ordinary email. Confirm role, mailbox, jurisdiction and channel purpose. Deliverability not tested.
